mapper.select: SELECT settlement.settlement_id FROM hr_final_settlement settlement JOIN wf_task task ON task.tenant_id = settlement.tenant_id AND task.instance_id = settlement.instance_id WHERE settlement.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND settlement.approval_status = 'SUBMITTED' AND settlement.status = 'DRAFT' AND task.task_id = #{taskId} AND task.assignee = #{actor} AND task.status = 'TODO' AND task.node_key = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.approval.financeNodeId'))

SELECT user_row.user_id FROM hr_employee employee JOIN sys_user user_row ON user_row.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND user_row.user_id = employee.user_id AND user_row.deleted = 0 WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.id = #{employeeId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee linked WHERE linked.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND linked.user_id = employee.user_id AND linked.deleted = 0) = 1

SELECT status FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0 AND start_user_id = #{submitter} AND definition_id = #{definitionId} AND business_key = CONCAT('HR_SETTLEMENT:', #{settlementId}, ':R', #{revision}) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(variables, '$.businessType')) = 'HR_SETTLEMENT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(variables, '$.businessId')) = CAST(#{settlementId} AS CHAR) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(variables, '$.settlementId')) = CAST(#{settlementId} AS CHAR) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(variables, '$.settlementRevision')) = CAST(#{revision} AS CHAR) FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_process_instance instance WHERE instance.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND instance.status = #{status} AND instance.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_task_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND history.instance_id = instance.instance_id AND history.node_key = #{nodeId} AND history.operator_id = #{actor} AND history.operator_id != instance.start_user_id AND history.on_behalf_of_user_id IS NULL AND history.create_time IS NOT NULL AND history.task_id IS NOT NULL AND history.task_id != '' AND history.task_type = 'OR_SIGN' AND ((#{status} = 'PASSED' AND history.action = 'COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE') OR (#{status} = 'REJECTED' AND history.action = 'COUNTERSIGN_REJECT')))
